facts.fact: The Ministry of Finance's FY2025 execution report to 31 December 2025 shows the digital ministry's (section 31) domestic investment adjusted to 2,094,407,522 F CFA from an initial 6,643,398,000 and ordered for payment at 2,094,406,682 F CFA, 100.00 percent (Annexe 5, domestic grain); ministry spending line only, no fund collections given.
facts.system: Section 31 Ministere de la Transition digitale, des Postes et des Communications electroniques - FY2025 domestic investment

facts.fact: The same FY2025 report gives section 31 total spending excluding personnel, external financing included, ordered for payment at 10,558,163,647 F CFA of 10,592,516,522 adjusted (99.68 percent); programme 136 Transformation et ecosysteme numerique 4,076,920,936 and programme 095 communications infrastructure 5,800,657,734 F CFA, so this is not a purely domestic figure.
